name: walk_to_point
prompt: A child walks forward to a point and stops
cmd: TEXT_ENCODER_DEVICE=cpu python -m kimodo.scripts.generate "A child walks forward to a point and stops" --model soma --duration 3.97 --constraints /workspace/constraints/walk_to_point.json --num_samples 1 --seed 7 --bvh --output /workspace/out/walk_to_point --bvh_standard_tpose

name: walk_sit
prompt: A child walks forward then sits down on the ground
cmd: TEXT_ENCODER_DEVICE=cpu python -m kimodo.scripts.generate "A child walks forward then sits down on the ground" --model soma --duration 4.97 --constraints /workspace/constraints/walk_sit.json --num_samples 1 --seed 7 --bvh --output /workspace/out/walk_sit --bvh_standard_tpose

name: turn90
prompt: A child walks, turns ninety degrees to the right, then continues walking
cmd: TEXT_ENCODER_DEVICE=cpu python -m kimodo.scripts.generate "A child walks, turns ninety degrees to the right, then continues walking" --model soma --duration 4.47 --constraints /workspace/constraints/turn90.json --num_samples 1 --seed 7 --bvh --output /workspace/out/turn90 --bvh_standard_tpose
